description: Search Datadog log events with a log query over an optional time range.

from.description: Start of the search time range as a Unix epoch timestamp in seconds.

limit.description: Maximum number of log events to return.

query.description: Datadog log search query using log search syntax, such as service and status filters.

to.description: End of the search time range as a Unix epoch timestamp in seconds.

name: search_logs
